Altoreva Adds Housekeeping to Hotel Operations Platform and Launches Two-Way Oracle OPERA Cloud Integration

facts.claim: Altoreva announced its Housekeeping module is live, integrating operations, security, and housekeeping into one platform.
Altoreva launched a two-way integration with Oracle OPERA Cloud, currently running at Eagle Aruba Resort.
The platform allows staff to read guest data from OPERA and write room status back to the PMS.
